tools.name: whp_standing_contract
tools.description: Discover WHP Standing: Machine-verifiable standing under explicit authority and bounds. Includes exact profile, schema, authority prerequisites and owner-authorized payment contract.

tools.name: whp_standing_evaluation
tools.description: Request a WHP Standing Evaluation. First call returns the exact HTTP 402 payment terms. Supply only the buyer’s own pre-authorized payment signature on retry. Paying does not establish standing; a failed assessment has no Mark.

tools.name: whp_standing_result
tools.description: Retrieve the exact original WHP Standing Mark or negative assessment bytes with buyer authentication, without another charge.
